mapper.select: select sp.store_nm from sys_plant sp where sp.plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and sp.use_yn = 'Y' and sp.delete_yn = 'N'
select smm.sys_id as category_sys_id, smm.category_name from store_menu_master smm where smm.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and smm.use_yn = 'Y' and smm.delete_yn = 'N' order by smm.ord_no asc

select smd.sys_id as menu_sys_id, smm.sys_id as category_sys_id, smm.category_name, smd.menu_name, smd.menu_price, smd.menu_description, ( select af.sys_id from attach_file af where af.link_sys_id = smd.file_ulid and af.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and af.delete_yn = 'N' order by af.ord_no asc limit 1 ) as file_sys_id, smd.menu_tag, smd.option_use_yn, smd.sold_out_yn from store_menu_detail smd inner join store_menu_master smm on smm.sys_id = smd.link_sys_id and smm.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and smm.use_yn = 'Y' and smm.delete_yn = 'N' where smd.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and smd.use_yn = 'Y' and smd.delete_yn = 'N' order by smm.ord_no asc, smd.ord_no asc
